voices.name: player
voices.description: A tired, grumpy hero in their thirties who is completely sick of everything. Low, slightly raspy voice with dry, deadpan delivery; sarcastic and unimpressed, muttering one-liners under their breath like a stand-up comedian. Natural, close-mic studio recording, American accent.
voices.sampleText: Oh, great. More of them. You know what, I had plans today. Big plans. Lying on the couch, ignoring the whole world, eating cereal for dinner. And instead I'm out here. Shooting slime. Fantastic.

voices.name: announcer
voices.description: Over-the-top retro arcade game announcer: booming, energetic and larger than life, slightly cheesy, big punchy emphasis on every word, like a 1990s arcade cabinet. Clean, loud studio recording, American accent.
voices.sampleText: Welcome, challenger! Get ready for the most intense, the most ridiculous, the most infernal battle of your entire life! Level one, begin! Final wave! Oh yeah, now we're talking!

voices.name: overlord
voices.description: An enormous ancient titan, the ruler of Hell: a very deep, slow, resonant bass voice, huge and calm, barely bothered, bored and tired of everything. Never raises his voice; every word sounds like it cost him nothing. Long pauses, low and heavy, a slight gravelly rumble. Clean studio recording, no effects, neutral accent.
voices.sampleText: Mm. [long pause] Stay. [pause] Another one. They always come up to look. A thousand floors, and every one of them the same. Fire. Screaming. The same fire. The same screaming. Forever. I have heard it all. [sighs] The surface will be quieter. Move. Or don't. It makes no difference to me.

voices.name: magmaKing
voices.description: A huge, heavy king made of molten slag, lounging on a throne he never gets up from: a very deep, thick, gurgling bass voice, slow, smug and amused, lazy and self-satisfied, proud, loves an audience and takes Hell's show seriously, every word rolling out like lava, a wet bubbling rasp in the throat. He never shouts; he chuckles. Clean studio recording, no effects, neutral accent.
voices.sampleText: I can hear you climbing, little spark. Every step. Hotter and hotter. Mm-hm-hm. Come up, then. Take your time. I'm not getting up. I never get up. The Wastes come to me, and the Wastes always burn.

voices.name: gloob
voices.description: Gloob, the village's green slime and its gossip: a small, friendly cartoon slime creature, male, mid-pitched and bubbly. Talks fast and chatty, a wet gurgly voice with little bubbling gulps between words, delighted to see anyone, a bit too pleased with himself, giggly. Clean studio recording.
voices.sampleText: Ooh! You! From the village! I KNEW I'd smelled a familiar face. Guess who swallowed the diamonds before the imps got 'em? Me. Gloob. Hee hee. Still got a few in here, actually.
